display_long_description:
Welcome back to the world of BrassVR—built bigger, smoother, and better than ever before! Bvr World Remastered is the definitive multiplayer social platformer where you throw away the controllers' joysticks and use your real arms to conquer the environment.

Features
Master the Ultimate Locomotion System: Experience the physics-based hand-tracking movement that started a revolution. Launch yourself off walls, climb towering obstacles, and chase down your friends across massive, multi-tiered maps using pure momentum.

The Ultimate Monke Hangout: Meet up with old friends and make new ones in fully interactive open worlds. Join active lobby rooms, customize your look, and engage in chaotic community-wide live events.

Face the Horror: Ready for a heart-pounding challenge? Step into the dark and see if you can outsmart the terrifying threats waiting for you in the revamped horror gamemode. One wrong move and it's game over!

Built For The Community: With optimized performance, crisp remastered visuals, and lag-free multiplayer networking, the world is smoother than it's ever been.

Whether you're casually swinging through the trees, executing flawless parkour lines, or fleeing from terrifying monsters in the dark, there is a space in the world for you.

What are you waiting for? Grab your headset, call the pack, and reject humanity. Become a bvr monke today!
